name: Acme Outdoor
about: Online shop for hiking boots, tents and camping gear, shipping across Europe.

topics.product_quality: The customer talks about how the product performs, lasts, fits or is made.
topics.shipping_delivery: The customer talks about delivery time, tracking, packaging or a parcel that is late, damaged or lost.
topics.price_value: The customer talks about price, discounts, shipping costs or whether the product is worth the money.
topics.customer_service: The customer talks about contact with support staff, replies, helpfulness or waiting times.
topics.billing_refund: The customer talks about payments, invoices, charges, refunds or returns.
topics.website_checkout: The customer talks about the website, the app, search, the cart or the checkout process.
topics.other: Anything else, or a review that gives no specific reason.

facts: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items.
Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 working days after the return is received.
Standard delivery in Europe takes 3 to 6 working days.
Customers can reach support by email at support@acme-outdoor.example.
never: promise a refund, replacement, discount or any compensation in a public reply
ask for an order number, email address, phone number or address in a public reply
blame the customer or argue about what happened
state a fact, deadline or policy that is not in the list of facts
